referee_caveats_inferred: SFR and dust mass rest on fixed T_dust=47 K, beta=1.6 and a single opacity law with no free SED parameters, so L_FIR, L_TIR and M_dust are model-dependent
Proximity-zone lifetime depends on the FIRE spectrum (low S/N, R~500-6000) and on a simulation grid; it is sensitive to possible obscured earlier accretion
Flux correction epsilon ~ 0.6 for the [C II] flux is described only briefly and could change the flux, L[CII] and SFR
Mg II velocity offset (237 +/- 150 km/s) shifts the black hole redshift relative to the [C II] systemic redshift, which may affect proximity zone sizing
ALMA part is a single execution at ~0.4'' resolution, so kinematic interpretation (mild gradient, merger hint) is weakly constrained

missing_for_reproduction: tclean image size, cell size, threshold, iterations and masks
Line-free channel selection for the continuum model and for the continuum maps
Aperture centre and method for dirty/clean/residual flux scaling (epsilon)
Gaussian fitting software and error treatment for [C II] and size fits
Code or scripts for SED integration, L_FIR/L_TIR and SFR calculations (formulas are given)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: One Band 6 execution of ~3145 s on source in C43-4; raw ASDM likely a few to ~10 GB, calibrated measurement set a few GB (estimate).
reproducibility.score_reason: Project code and observing mode, natural weighting, aperture, formulas and assumed dust parameters are given and results are numeric, but CASA version, calibrators, cell/image size, clean threshold and line-free channels are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA project 2019.1.01436.S is listed and observed in 2019 so the data are likely public after the proprietary period (not stated by the paper); the ALMA recipe and formulas are mostly complete and the key results (flux densities, [C II] flux, M_dust, L_FIR, SFR) are numeric.
